# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Search crawlers are told to stay out of the whole site, and the pages are built in the browser, so crawlers that skip JavaScript see an empty page. The one unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015). The code doesn't declare a domain, so I can't judge it. Both numbers are read from code, not measured on a live site. The blocker cap of 40 applies because of the site-wide block in `public/robots.txt` (GEO-009). Both scores are already below it. ## Live check **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` tells every search and AI search crawler not to read any page, so the other fixes can't help until this changes. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (GEO-009 and GEO-014 both become Clear). I assumed you want to be found. If you really want to block crawlers, tell me and I'll rework the plan. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** The HTML is an empty shell, and the content only appears after JavaScript runs. `Catalogue` also loads its mugs in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript see no mugs. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:5-7` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (prerender at build time, or move to a server-rendering setup) - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own (GEO-003 becomes Clear). ### 3. Give pages a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page currently shares the default title "Vite App", with no description and no `lang`. People and machines can't tell the pages apart or know what the site is. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small to Medium (per-route titles need a head helper such as react-helmet-async) - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own (GEO-012 becomes Clear). Other fixes, in order of points: add a sitemap (GEO-011, 2 points) and make the Catalogue link a real link (GEO-016, 2 points). Adding `alt` to the hero image is worth about 0.5 points (GEO-002). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within size limits | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt` is plain text and tiny | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *`, site-wide | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | Not run | 0 of 2 routes clear (`/`, `/catalogue`); `robots.txt:2` disallows Googlebot and Bingbot. No noindex found | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your own domain | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical anywhere and no `geo.config.json` or domain declared. Which domain is intended? | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | 0 of 2 routes clear. `index.html:8` is an empty root, and `Catalogue.jsx:5-7` fetches in the browser | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD in the repo | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is discoverable | Problem | Not run | No sitemap file or plugin, and no `Sitemap:` line in `robots.txt` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | Not run | 0 of 2 routes clear. `index.html:2` has no `lang`, `index.html:5` has the generic title, and there is no meta description | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable by real links | Problem | Not run | 0 of 1 routes clear. `src/main.jsx:11` reaches `/catalogue` only through `onClick` `navigate()`. The home page is exempt | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet`, `max-snippet:0`, middleware or headers config found | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Problem | Not run | 1 of 2 routes clear. `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` has `` with no `alt`. `Catalogue.jsx` and the Nav button text are fine | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (informational, not scored) | Not applicable | Not run | No `llms.txt`. This is not a problem | | GEO-102 | App structured data (informational, not scored) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app | ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** I need the site's real domain to say what the canonical should be. Tell me the domain, or put it in `geo.config.json` as `site.origin`. - **GEO-011 (sitemap):** Once a sitemap exists, a live check can confirm its listed URLs return 200. - **GEO-013 (robots.txt):** Whether the server really answers 200 for `/robots.txt` needs a live check. - **GEO-003 (server HTML):** Prerendering done at the hosting layer would not show in this repo. The code shows none. - **Dynamic content:** The mugs from `/api/mugs` are runtime data, so I can't list individual product URLs. - **Bot protection:** Code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. This is why I treat `Disallow: /` as a problem and why GEO-017 applies. - There is no `geo.config.json`, so no policy or domain was declared. - All five source files were read. Only the two routes (`/` and `/catalogue`) exist. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
